subject: Artifact Health — Kickoff: scheduling, attendee confirmations, and fallback bridges

To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff — scheduling request and attendee list

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to lock in a kickoff to get the implementation started. Goal is to align on milestones, SCIM/SAML access, and the initial data retention settings so our security/compliance folks have visibility.

A few constraints on our side:
- Primary stakeholders available next week Tuesday & Thursday afternoons (PST)
- We need the SOW attached to be acknowledged by procurement before the technical session (they asked for 48 hours)

Tentative attendees on our side: me (Elena, PM), Samir Shah (IT lead), and Maya Lopez (Security). I'll confirm if additional folks join.

Can you propose two 90-minute windows and include the join links? Also please include a short agenda and fallback bridges in case our Zoom hits the company firewall.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Program Manager | Artifact Health
elena@artifacthealth.com
Attachments: ArtifactHealth_Onboarding_SOW_v1.pdf

Links I'll send once Marissa confirms the agenda. If Tue works we can lock that and I'll send calendar invites with dial-in options.

5) 15:20–15:30 — Actions, docs, next steps (Marissa)

- Primary: Redwood-hosted Zoom (Zoom): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=bridge
